title: Raw affine derived-Hom classes descend before sheafification
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ a diagram with affine transitions and qcqs structure maps, and $c$ a cone with limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure map. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, and $f_i:X\to X_i$. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with inverse-image maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the identity and composition HEq equations in the Lean signature. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathrm{Ab})$ have isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\simeq f_i^{-1}F_i$ and the canonical transition equation written in the Lean signature, and put $F=\operatorname{colim}H$. Fix $p\in\mathbb N$. Define $P_i(U)=\operatorname{Hom}((g_i^{-1}\mathbb Z[U])[0],F_i[0][p])$ and $P(U)=\operatorname{Hom}((g^{-1}\mathbb Z[U])[0],F[0][p])$, using [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For every affine etale $U\to S$ and $z\in P(U)$, there are $i\in I$ and $t\in P_i(U)$ with $b_{f_i}(t)=z$. Here $b_{f_i}$ is the explicitly constructed raw pullback map of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison], with coefficient map exactly $(eH_i)^{-1}\mathbin{\gg}\operatorname{colimit}.\iota_i$. No sheafification isomorphism or higher-image section is asserted.

proof.text: Base change D and c along affine U. Each stage map to U is qcqs by base change, hence each stage scheme is qcqs; transitions remain affine. The pullback universal property proves that the new cone is limiting. Restrict the coefficient system and transport its identity, composition and H-transition equations by pullback-composition comparisons. Inverse image preserves colimits, identifying the limit coefficient with restriction of colimit H.

Use degree-zero single complexes, zero below zero. Apply nonempty_isColimit_etale_complex_cohomology to the base-changed system. The prescribed canonical cohomology cocone is a filtered colimit. Its image under forget to types is a colimit, so every element at the limit is the image of a class at a stage.

Identify restricted cohomology with derived Hom from the pulled-back free abelian representable. The free-sheaf sections adjunction corepresents sections on the etale base-changed scheme, and etale restriction preserves injectives by its exact left adjoint. The fully faithful bounded-below inclusion identifies these Hom groups with the unbounded cohomology of the single complexes. Naturality identifies the cocone leg with the explicit raw pullback and shifted coefficient map. Transport the stage representative to t, obtaining rawPullback(t)=z without sheafification.
